messages:
nina: quick heads-up: drafting a runtime policy change for API key scoping. idea: disallow org-scoped wildcard keys from being accepted by service endpoints by default. require either project-scoped keys or a short-lived broker token.
ryan: sounds sensible. what's the operational impact? any customer-facing APIs using org keys?
sahil: internal infra and some CI flows currently use org keys. we need a migration story or we risk breaking builds.
tessa: propose phased rollout: 1) detection-only mode in gateway for 2 weeks + alert owners 2) deny-by-default in a canary cluster with allowlist entries 3) org-key creation UX changes and TTL defaults 4) long-term broker to mint project tokens.
nina: detection-first is good. gateway can emit detections to a new audit stream. auth-bot: policy staged: scope_enforce=v0 mode=detect gateway=alpha.
ryan: for semantics, define "org wildcard" explicitly: key.metadata.scopes == ["*"] OR key.binding=="org" and not key.bound_projects. make it machine-checkable.
sahil: allowlist should be limited to named operator principals with justification + expiry. also require manual owner field on allowlist entries.
tessa: devex UX: when a user creates an org key, show a clear banner: "Org keys are broad; for runtime services use project tokens or request a broker token." option to auto-create a migration ticket.
nina: regarding RBAC, if services must access multiple projects we don't want to create long-lived keys per project. broker pattern: service authenticates with its identity, broker issues short-lived project token after ACL check. reduces key sprawl.
ryan: agree. make broker telemetry include original principal, requested project, and allowed scopes. propagate these fields to logs/traces.
sahil: one wrinkle: batch jobs that assume many projects in bulk. broker needs a batch minting API or a batching TTL to avoid thundering. mention in RFC.
tessa: I'll add migration checklist items: update deploy lint rules, set gateway detect-only, send owner notices, provide ops allowlist flow, build broker PoC.
nina: thanks. I'll write the RFC draft and post later today. can people review by EOD Friday?
ryan: can review.
sahil: can review Friday.
auth-bot: ticket created INFRA-5017 to track scope enforcement rollout and INFRA-5018 for broker PoC.
